name: model-router
description: Runs each turn and subagent on the smallest model that fits the task; protected work stays on the top model.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: auto switches models, suggest only shows what it would pick, off does nothing.

midModel.title: Mid-tier model
midModel.description: Alias or full id for everyday implementation work.

smallModel.title: Small-tier model
smallModel.description: Alias or full id for lookups, summaries, trivial edits and test runs.

contextLimit.title: Downshift context limit (tokens)
contextLimit.description: Above this many tokens in the live context, the main thread stays on its own model.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: rules is local regex only. rules+model also asks the small model about prompts the rules cannot place.
